name: L2G-NeRF
aliases: L2G-NeRF (Local-to-Global Registration for Bundle-Adjusting Neural Radiance Fields)
Local-to-Global Registration for Bundle-Adjusting Neural Radiance Fields
definition: A bundle-adjusting NeRF method that jointly optimizes neural field parameters and camera poses by combining a local photometric alignment objective with a global geometric alignment objective.
summary: L2G-NeRF is a bundle-adjusting method for Neural Radiance Fields that jointly optimizes 3D representations and camera poses by combining local photometric and global geometric alignment objectives to tolerate large initial errors.
